Wrong metric recorder on Create storage failure - calls recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration when d.Storage.Create fails, misattributing the failure metric
Wrong metric recorder on Update storage failure - calls recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration when d.Storage.Update fails, misattributing the error metric

Wrong metric recorder for legacy DeleteCollection in goroutine - d.Legacy.DeleteCollection duration is recorded with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration, causing legacy metrics to appear as storage metrics

Goroutines inherit cancellable request context causing async writes to fail silently - all four async goroutines derive their timeout context from the incoming request ctx, which gets cancelled when HTTP response is sent, aborting legacy writes before the 10-second timeout has any effect. Should use context.Background() as the base

Enriched logger not stored in context - klog.NewContext is called with d.Log (base logger) instead of the enriched log that was constructed with name, kind, and method values, causing those fields to be absent from log lines

name passed instead of options.Kind to metric recorder in Delete - passes resource name instead of options.Kind as third argument to recordStorageDuration, producing high-cardinality metric label and preventing meaningful aggregation
